name: Progressive taper funnel
definition: Stacked level bars narrowing step by step, each a share of the level above, revealed one level at a time, with the target group highlighted.
bestUse: Sizing a problem down to the group you will focus on.

demo.how: Each bar is a share of the level above, so the audience follows the narrowing one step at a time instead of seeing the end number cold. Press Reveal next level to add a level, or Show all; the last level is highlighted as the focus group. Reset hides all but the first. Numbers are illustrative.
